docs.title: HarnMaster 3.5E for Fantasy Grounds Unity
docs.text:
Welcome to the documentation for the HarnMaster 3.5E ruleset for Fantasy Grounds Unity.

This ruleset implements the HarnMaster 3rd Edition rules for Fantasy Grounds Unity, focusing on gritty, realistic combat mechanics, detailed injury tracking, and an authentic percentile-based skill system.

docs.title: Key Features
docs.text:
• Detailed Hit Location System: Full implementation of HarnMaster's hit location tables with zone targeting (High, Mid, Low) and specific body part tracking.
  • Automated Combat Resolution Matrix: Automated calculation of attacker vs. defender outcomes (Critical/Marginal Success & Failure) using official HarnMaster combat matrices.
  • Realistic Injuries & Healing: Direct generation of injuries (Minor, Serious, Grievous), blood loss, shock checks, and automated Medical Resolution.
  • Skill-Based Character Management: Percentile checks (ML vs. D100), Skill Base (SB) calculations from attributes, Sunsign modifiers, and development tracking.
  • Magic & Mystic Powers: Chantry/Convocation spellcasting and ritual tracking.

docs.title: Documentation Quick Links
docs.text:
• 📖 User Manual — Comprehensive guide on character sheets, making rolls, combat flow, and GM tools.
  • ⚔️ Combat Resolution — Step-by-step guide to using the interactive Combat Resolution Window (CRW), hit location overrides, and damage application.
  • 📋 Status Effects & Conditions — Canonical reference for conditions, shock/trauma checks, bleeder tracking, and FGU effect syntax.

docs.title: Installation & Modules
docs.text:
1. Subscribe to the HarnMaster 3.5E ruleset on the Fantasy Grounds Forge.
  2. Open the Fantasy Grounds Unity launcher and click Check for Updates to download the ruleset and associated packages.
  3. Create a new campaign and choose HarnMaster as the ruleset.

docs.title: Official Modules
docs.text:
The ruleset includes and supports official modules:

  • HarnMaster 3.5E Core Rules (HarnMaster3.5E_Core_Rules.mod): Comprehensive rulebook and reference manual data, including skills, items, weapons, armor, bestiary creatures, and default strike location tables.
  • HarnMaster Magic (HarnMaster3.5E_Magic.mod): Complete Shek-Pvar magic compendium containing all 82 canonical spells across Gray (Neutral) and all six Convocational chantries, with built-in action automation.
  • HarnMaster Tuzyn Calendar (HarnMaster3.5E_Calendar.mod): Official 360-day Harnic calendar with all 12 months, celestial holidays, and moon phases.
  • HarnMaster Assets (HarnMaster3.5E_Assets.mod): High-resolution Harnic tabletop decals and atmospheric assets.

Automatic Activation: All installed HarnMaster modules are automatically activated for the Game Master and configured for player auto-load when a campaign is loaded. No manual setup in the Modules activation window is required.

docs.title: Combat Resolution
docs.text: The Combat Resolution Window (CRW) is the central interactive hub in Fantasy Grounds Unity for resolving HarnMaster combat. Whenever an attack is made, this window opens automatically for the Game Master, coordinating the attacker's roll, the defender's tactical response, hit location determinations, armor deductions, and injury generation.

docs.title: Overview & Workflow
docs.text:
graph TD
    A[1. Attack Initiated] --> B[CRW Opens for GM]
    B --> C[2. Defender Action Chosen & Rolled]
    C --> D[3. Matrix Outcome Calculated]
    D --> E[4. Hit Location Verified / Adjusted]
    E --> F[5. Armor Subtracted & Injury Computed]
    F --> G[6. Click 'Apply Result']
    G --> H[Wounds, CT Effects & Chat Updated]
  1. Attack Initiated: A player or GM rolls an attack from the character sheet or Combat Tracker.
  2. Window Opens: The Combat Resolution Window opens, populated with the attacker's weapon, roll result, aim zone, and base damage aspect.
  3. Defender Rolls: The defender chooses their defense action (Block, Dodge, Counterstrike, or Ignore) and rolls. The CRW updates immediately.
  4. Outcome Displayed: The Combat Matrix result is calculated and displayed (e.g. A*2, D*1, Block).
  5. Hit Location & Armor: The struck body part is highlighted in the location grid. Effective Impact is computed against the defender's worn armor at that location.
  6. Confirmation: The GM reviews or overrides any field and clicks Apply Result to apply injuries and effects to the Combat Tracker and character sheet.

docs.title: Window Interface Breakdown
docs.text:
The Combat Resolution Window is divided into intuitive, collapsible panels:

┌────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│  Combat Resolution                                     │
├────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤
│  Attacker: Broadsword (ML 65)                          │
│  Attacker Test: [ Marginal Success (MS)  ▼ ]           │
│  Defender Action: [ Block                ▼ ]           │
│  Defender Test: [ Marginal Failure (MF)  ▼ ]           │
│  Matrix Result: A*2 (Attacker Hits x2)                 │
│  [ Announce Roll to Chat ]                             │
├────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤
│  Damage Aspect: [ Edge ▼ ]   Side: [ Left ▼ ]          │
│  Base Impact: [ 12 ]       Effective Impact: [ 7 ]     │
│  Injury Level: Serious Wound (S3)                      │
├────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤
│  STRIKE LOCATIONS                                      │
│  [ Skull ]  [ Forearm ]  [ > L. Shoulder < ]  [ Thigh ] │
├────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤
│  [ Apply Result ]                   [ Cancel ]         │
└────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘

docs.title: 1. Roll Results Panel
docs.text:
This section tracks the opposed check and matrix lookup:

  • Attacker Weapon & Test: Shows the weapon name and attacker success level (CS - Critical Success, MS - Marginal Success, MF - Marginal Failure, CF - Critical Failure). The GM can cycle through these if a manual adjustment or GM fiat is desired.
  • Defender Action: A cycler allowing selection of the defender's reaction:
    • Block: Uses weapon/shield defense Mastery Level.
    • Counterstrike: Defender attacks simultaneously; both rolls are compared on the matrix.
    • Dodge: Agility-based evasion test.
    • Ignore: Defender takes no defensive action (auto Critical Failure for defense).
  • Defender Test: The defender's rolled success level (CS, MS, MF, CF).
  • Matrix Result: Automatically looks up the interaction in official HarnMaster tables:
    • A*1, A*2, A*3, A*4: Attacker hits with indicated impact multiplier.
    • D*1, D*2: Defender counterstrike hits attacker.
    • Block / Dodge: Attack is completely neutralized.
    • --: Tactical standoff; neither side deals damage.
  • Announce Roll: Clicking this button broadcasts the current attack/defense narrative and matrix result to the chat log for all players to see.

docs.title: 2. Damage & Injury Calculation Panel
docs.text:
When the matrix indicates a successful hit, this panel calculates injury severity:

  • Damage Aspect: Displays the active weapon aspect (Blunt, Edge, Point, or Fire). Can be cycled to adjust for special weapon usage or damage types.
  • Side (Left / Right): Indicates whether the left or right side of the body was struck.
  • Creature Size Difference Impact: Automatically calculates the difference between attacker and defender size steps (e.g. Medium vs. Large) and applies ±1 impact per size step difference directly to the base impact.
  • Base Impact & Effective Impact:
    • Base Impact: Weapon impact multiplied by the matrix multiplier (A * N), modified by creature size difference.
    • Effective Impact (EI): Automatically deducts the defender's worn armor value covering the specific hit location.
    • Cover Mitigation: If the target has active Cover (Low Cover, High Cover, or Full Cover) protecting the struck body part, the obstacle's Plate armor rating (B6/E10/P6/F2) is automatically applied to mitigate incoming damage.
  • Injury Level: Displays the computed wound severity (Minor, Serious, Grievous, or Amputation) based on the body part and remaining Effective Impact.
  • Multi-Hit & Spell Damage Resolution: For spells, flurries, or multi-target attacks with multiple strikes, the CRW displays a multi-hit list entry for each strike, allowing individual resolution of strike locations, armor penetration, and resulting injury levels.

docs.title: 3. Hit Location Grid, Lateral Side Selector & Face Sub-Table
docs.text:
The window includes an interactive body location picker:

  • Automated Roll Selection: The location determined by the attack roll is automatically highlighted in red.
  • Manual Override: The GM can click any location button (e.g., Skull, Thorax, Forearm, Thigh) to change the targeted location on the fly; the effective impact and armor values recalculate immediately.
  • Lateral Side Selection Grid (Left / Right): Whenever a lateral location is struck (e.g. Shoulder, Arm, Elbow, Forearm, Hand, Thigh, Knee, Calf, Foot), a secondary side grid dynamically appears below the hit location table:
    • Automated Highlight: Automatically highlights the side determined by the roll (odd roll = Left, even roll = Right).
    • Interactive Switching: Clicking Left or Right updates the wound location, worn armor calculation, and injury stats immediately.
  • Face Sub-Location Grid: If the struck location is Face, a secondary sub-grid appears allowing granular targeting for:
    • Eye, Cheek, Nose, Mouth, Jaw, or Ear (with the lateral side selector appearing if Eye or Ear is chosen).

docs.title: 4. NPC Defender Actions Panel
docs.text: When attacking an NPC, the window displays the NPC's available actions, traits, and combat powers directly below the damage panel. This allows the GM to quickly review special defenses, resistances, or reactions without needing to open the NPC stat sheet.

docs.title: 5. Applying the Result
docs.text:
At the bottom of the window:

  • Apply Result:
    • Applies the calculated wound directly to the defender's Injuries Tab.
    • Updates current total injury penalties on the character sheet and Combat Tracker.
    • Generates required Shock Rolls, Stumble/Knockdown prompts, or Bleeding rates in the chat window.
    • Closes the Combat Resolution Window.
  • Cancel: Closes the resolution window without applying any damage or status changes.

docs.title: Counterstrike Handling
docs.text: When a defender chooses Counterstrike: 1. The defender makes an attack roll against the original attacker. 2. The resolution matrix compares both rolls. 3. If the defender succeeds, a linked secondary resolution window opens with the roles reversed, allowing immediate resolution of the counterstrike impact and injury.

docs.title: HarnMaster Status Effects & Conditions Reference
docs.text:
This document provides a comprehensive canonical compendium of status effects, conditions, trauma states, afflictions, and enchantments in HarnMaster (Third Edition / 3.5E), synthesized from: - HarnMaster Core Rules (3e) - HarnMaster Magic (Shek-Pvar) - HarnMaster Religion (Libram of the Pantheon)

It includes standard rules mechanics, resistance tests (Saving Throws), durations, and exact Fantasy Grounds Unity (FGU) effect strings for automation.

docs.title: 1. Physical Combat & Trauma Status Effects
docs.text: These conditions stem from physical injuries, tactical combat maneuvers, fatigue, infections, and environmental hazards.

docs.title: Consciousness & Shock
docs.text: Status Effect Source / Trigger Rule Mechanics Duration & Recovery FGU Effect Syntax Shock Check Taking any injury Roll 1d6 per Universal Penalty (UP). If total exceeds Endurance, character collapses. Instantaneous trigger [SHOCK CHECK] Unconscious Failed Shock Roll or Trauma Character is helpless. Drops held items, falls Prone, cannot make actions or tests. Opponents gain automatic Tactical Advantage. Defenses are ignored (DEF: Ignore), resulting in uncontested strikes. 1 minute recovery checks (Shock recovery table); then 10 min checks. Unconscious; Prone; DEF: Ignore Incapacitated Passing first recovery check from Unconscious Transitional recovery state. Must immediately roll a second Shock Check: Pass = full recovery; Fail = degrades into Shock. Initiative penalized by -10. Instant / 1 round Incapacitated; INIT: -10 Shock (Medical State) Degraded from Incapacitated or Trauma threshold Critical state with Healing Rate H5 (no injury levels). Requires a Shock Recovery roll every 4 hours (Target = HR × END). Reaches H6 = recovered; H0 = death. 4-hour checks until H6 or death Shock; CHECK: -20

docs.title: Mobility, Balance & Posture
docs.text: Status Effect Source / Trigger Rule Mechanics Duration & Recovery FGU Effect Syntax Stumble Leg injury (S2+), Knockback, sudden terrain shift Roll Agility check (modified by UP). Failure causes loss of balance: character drops to Prone, suffers Tactical Disadvantage. 1 round (until character stands) Stumble; Prone Fumble Arm/Shoulder injury (S2+), Wild attack result Roll Dexterity check. Failure causes weapon or shield to be dropped, misdirected, or damaged. Instantaneous Fumble Prone (Knockdown) Result of Stumble, tackle, or impact Character is on the ground. Suffers -20 EML on attacks and defenses (ATK: -20; DEF: -20). Standing opponents striking a prone target gain +20 EML. Costs half movement to stand. Until standing (requires move action) Prone; ATK: -20; DEF: -20 Knockback Effective blunt/physical impact > Strength Character is forced backward 1 hex (5 ft) per threshold. Must make an immediate Stumble Roll. Instantaneous Knockback: 1 hex Disarmed Tactical maneuver or critical fumble Weapon is dislodged, knocked away, or pinned. Character must draw another weapon or fight unarmed. Until retrieved or switched Disarmed Restrained / Grappled Grapple, entanglement, pinning Move reduced to 0. Suffers -20 EML on non-grapple actions and defenses. Opponents gain +20 EML against the restrained target. Until broken via STR or AGL contest Restrained; ATK: -20; DEF: -20

docs.title: Wounds, Bleeding & Crippling
docs.text: Status Effect Source / Trigger Rule Mechanics Duration & Recovery FGU Effect Syntax Bleeder (Bloodloss) Grievous wound (G4, G5) from Blunt, Edge, or Point Accumulates 1 Bloodloss Point (1 BP) every minute. BPs act as a cumulative injury. If total BPs exceed Endurance, victim dies of exsanguination. Continuous until treated (Tourniquet, Pressure, Cauterization, Magic) Bleeding: 1 BP/min Limb Crippled / Unusable Grievous injury (G4, G5) to arm, leg, wing, or tail Limb is completely non-functional. Leg: crawl or crutch (half Move); Arm: cannot hold items or parry. Biped with 1 bad leg crawls; with 2 bad legs immobilized. Until wound heals to M1 Crippled Limb; CHECK: -20 Amputation / Severed Limb Grievous Edge strike to extremity Body part is severed if damage roll exceeds 1/10th body weight. Automatically becomes a G5 wound, causes automatic Stumble/Fumble, and creates an immediate Bleeder. Permanent Amputated; Bleeding: 1 BP/min; CHECK: -30 Blinded (Single Eye) Puncture/Slash to eye location (S2+) Loss of binocular vision. Permanent -20 EML on missile weapons, visual awareness, and depth perception. Permanent unless magically restored Blinded Eye; CHECK: -20 eyesight Blinded (Complete) Both eyes destroyed, flash spells, venom Total loss of sight. Suffers -40 EML on attacks and -20 EML on defenses (reliant on acoustic awareness). Movement halved; tactile awareness tests required. Permanent or spell duration Blinded; ATK: -40; DEF: -20 Deafened Skull/Ear trauma, thunder spells/miracles Inability to hear auditory cues. Automatic failure on Hearing tests. -20 EML on surprise checks; verbal communication impossible. Medical recovery or spell duration Deafened; CHECK: -30 hearing

docs.title: Physiological & Environmental Conditions
docs.text: Status Effect Source / Trigger Rule Mechanics Duration & Recovery FGU Effect Syntax Fatigue (FL) Exertion, heavy armor, heat, spells Each Fatigue Level adds +1 to Universal Penalty (UP) (-10% to all skills and +1d6 to Shock rolls). Recorded directly in the sheet/CT FT box. 1 FL recovers per 10 minutes of resting Native FT Box: +1 FT per FL Encumbered Load exceeds carrying capacity Encumbrance Penalty (EP) directly subtracts from all physical skills (Move, Dodge, Acrobatics, Combat). Move rate halved or quartered. Until load is dropped or adjusted Encumbered; CHECK: -10; SPEED: /2 Infected (INF) Open wound failing 5-day Healing Roll Wound becomes infected. Tested daily on Infection Table (HR × END). Lowers HR on failure. Sepsis/Gangrene causes death if HR reaches H0. Defeated at HR6. Daily tests until defeated or death Infected; HR: -1 Diseased Pathogen exposure (Contagion Index 1-7) Character suffers specific disease symptoms (Fever, Delirium, Chills, Nausea). Applies a Special Penalty of -10 to -30 to physical skills. Tested daily. Daily recovery tests (HR1-HR5) Diseased; CHECK: -20 Poisoned (Venom) Toxin via injection, ingestion, contact Categories: Irritant (-10 to -30 penalty), Paralytic (stiffness to complete paralysis), Soporific (drowsiness/sleep), Lethal (rapid tissue death). Evaluated like fast-acting infections. Hours, minutes, or rounds depending on toxin Poisoned; CHECK: -20 Burning (On Fire) Flammable impact, fire magic, Greek fire Inflicts 1d6 Fire (F) damage per round. Equipment may ignite. Requires a full round and Agility test (or rolling on ground) to extinguish. Until smothered, doused, or consumed Burning: 1d6 F Frostbite / Hypothermia Extreme cold, Odivshe ice magic Mild: Shivering, numbness (-10 Special Penalty); Serious: 2nd degree frostbite (blisters); Grievous: 3rd degree (gangrene, requires amputation). Warming over 1d3 hours or medical care Frostbite; CHECK: -10 Asphyxiation / Drowning Submersion, choking, smoke, vacuum Deprived of air. Can hold breath for Endurance × 10 seconds. Afterward, makes an Endurance check each round (cumulative -10 penalty). Failure = Unconscious, followed by death in 1d3 rounds. Rounds until air is restored or death Asphyxiating; Drowning

docs.title: Morale & Combat Mindsets
docs.text: Status Effect Source / Trigger Rule Mechanics Duration & Recovery FGU Effect Syntax Frightened / Morale Broken Leader casualty, severe wounds, terrifying foes Failed Morale check (Will × multiplier). Character panics, retreats, or surrenders. Cannot initiate attacks; focuses purely on flight or defensive parries (-20 EML attack / -10 EML defense). Until rallying check or combat ends Frightened; ATK: -20; DEF: -10 Berserk / Battle Rage Cultural trait, Sarajin miracles, frenzy Character enters an uncontrollable bloodlust. Ignores all pain, shock, and fatigue penalties. Gains +20 EML to attack. Cannot parry, dodge, or disengage until all enemies fall. Duration of melee engagement Berserk; ATK: 20; IGNOREPENALTY Tactical Advantage (TA) Combat Matrix outcome (CS vs CF/MF, or tactical maneuvers) The victor of a combat exchange earns Tactical Advantage, allowing them to dictate the next exchange (initiative, posture, or +10/+20 EML on follow-up attack) over their opponent. 1 exchange / active round ATK: 20 Tactical Disadvantage Outmaneuvered, poor footing, restricted space Actor is put at tactical disadvantage by opponent; suffers -20 EML on combat actions. 1 exchange / active round ATK: -20; DEF: -20

docs.title: 2. Esoteric & Psionic Status Effects
docs.text:
Psionic talents represent innate psychic phenomena that bypass physical armor and directly target mind or physiology.

docs.title: 3. Arcane Magical Status Effects (HarnMaster Magic)
docs.text: Across the six Shek-Pvar chantries and Gray (Neutral) magic, spells generate distinct tactile and supernatural conditions.

docs.title: Lyahvi (Air / Light / Illusion)
docs.text:
• Globe of Setath (III): Creates a fascinating, multi-colored hovering sphere.
  • Save: Will × 4 (MS Globe) / Will × 2 (CS Globe)
  • CF: Stationary, gazing into globe until removed; cannot make rolls (Fascinated; Stunned).
  • MF: Gazes helplessly for 10 seconds; roll to break free each 10s (Stunned; dur: 1 rnd).
  • MS: Distracted for 10s; opponents earn tactical advantage; suffers -10 Special Penalty and -10 defense (Distracted; CHECK: -10; DEF: -10; dur: 1 rnd).
  • CS: Ignores globe.
  • Hlandor's Flash (II): Sudden brilliant pulse of light.
  • Save: Eyesight test.
  • Effect: Blinded and disoriented for 1d6 rounds (MS) or 2d6 minutes (CS). Attacks at -40 EML; defense at -20 EML.
  • FGU Effect: Blinded; ATK: -40; DEF: -20; dur: 1d6 rnd
  • Cloak of Kalaerin (II): Bends light around the recipient.
  • Effect: Invisible / Concealed. Attacks against recipient suffer -20 EML penalty. Recipient gains +20 EML on stealth and attacks from unseen posture.
  • FGU Effect: Invisible; ATK: 20; DEF: 20
  • Prism of Gethan (III): Disorienting rainbow aura.
  • Effect: Targets dazzled by shifting hues; -10 Special Penalty on visual and combat rolls.
  • FGU Effect: Dazzled; CHECK: -10
  • Maslor's Charm (VII): Potent compulsion of light and charisma.
  • Save: Will test.
  • Effect: Target is completely Charmed; regards caster as absolute master, incapable of harmful intent.
  • FGU Effect: Charmed; PACIFIED
  • Aeric's Whisper (I): Phantasmal auditory illusion.
  • Effect: Distracts guards or opponents; forces Awareness checks or imposes surprise.
  • FGU Effect: Distracted; CHECK: -10
  • Vapor of Hirin (VI): Dense illusory obscuration.
  • Effect: Total visual cover; all creatures inside treated as Blinded to exterior lines of sight.
  • FGU Effect: Obscured; Blinded

docs.title: Peleahn (Fire / Heat)
docs.text:
• Zyrgin's Heat (I): Radiates intense thermal energy.
  • Save: Endurance test.
  • Effect: Induces Heat Exhaustion and dehydration. Target accrues 1 Fatigue Level per round.
  • FGU Effect: Heat Exhaustion; Native FT Box: +1 FT/round
  • Sphere of Shanakar (I) & Sea of Fire (IV): Flaming burst or wave.
  • Effect: Deals direct Fire (F) damage and Ignites victims. Victims catch fire (1d6 F damage/round until extinguished).
  • FGU Effect: Burning: 1d6 F
  • Skin of Lexesh (II): Molten defensive mantle.
  • Effect: Grants Fire Immunity / Absorption and inflicts 1d6 F damage on unarmed/melee attackers striking the caster.
  • FGU Effect: Fire Warded; DMGTHORNS: 1d6 F
  • Aidan's Hastening (II): Cellular hyper-acceleration.
  • Effect: Hastened. Movement doubled; gains +20 EML to Initiative and an additional defensive/combat option per round.
  • FGU Effect: Hastened; INIT: 20; SPEED: *2
  • Charachi's Fever (IV): Thermal somatic infection.
  • Save: Endurance test.
  • Effect: Severe internal fever, delirium, and shivering. Imposes -20 Special Penalty to all mental and physical actions; progressive fatigue.
  • FGU Effect: Fevered; Delirious; CHECK: -20
  • Bolts of Dag (V): Concentrated projectile plasma.
  • Effect: Severe trauma + fire damage; forces immediate Stumble and Shock rolls.
  • FGU Effect: Burn Trauma; Stumble

docs.title: Jmorvi (Metal / Mineral)
docs.text:
• Aspect of Tarus (II): Transmutes outer skin into mineral hardness.
  • Effect: Grants +4 to +8 physical armor protection (Blunt, Edge, Point), but increases weight and imposes -10 to Agility/Acrobatics.
  • FGU Effect: Armor Buff: 6; AGL: -10
  • Anvil of Pytama (III) & Fist of Kuhan (IV): Telekinetic kinetic bludgeon.
  • Effect: Heavy blunt impact; forces automatic Knockback (1-3 hexes) and mandatory Stumble Roll.
  • FGU Effect: Knockback; Stumble
  • Barl's Cloak (VI): Sheaths target in malleable metallic carapace.
  • Effect: Extreme armor value (+12), but reduces Move by half and adds 2 Encumbrance Levels.
  • FGU Effect: Metal Cloak; ARMOR: 12; SPEED: /2
  • Sirik's Cant (III): Molecular reinforcement or degradation of metals.
  • Effect: Can render an opponent's weapon brittle (shatters on next impact > 5) or reinforce ally weapons.
  • FGU Effect: Brittle Weapon

docs.title: Fyvria (Earth / Flora / Fauna)
docs.text:
• Dream of Galega (IV): Enchanted natural slumber.
  • Save: Will × 5.
  • CF: Asleep for 2d6 hours (Unconscious; Asleep).
  • MF: Asleep for 1d6 hours (Unconscious; Asleep).
  • MS: Drowsy for 1d6 rounds (Drowsy; CHECK: -10).
  • CS: Unaffected.
  • Verdant Hand (II) & Hand of Iliam (II): Animated undergrowth and roots.
  • Save: Agility or Strength check.
  • Effect: Targets in area are Entangled / Restrained. Move reduced to 0; -20 EML on attacks; opponents gain +20 EML against them.
  • FGU Effect: Entangled; Restrained; ATK: -20; DEF: -20
  • Vine of Alguinas (IV): Constricting magical creepers.
  • Effect: Grappled & Choked. Inflicts 1d6 Blunt impact per round; forces Asphyxiation checks if wrapped around torso/neck.
  • FGU Effect: Constricted; Asphyxiating
  • Balm of Gresan (I): Accelerated biological coagulation.
  • Effect: Immediately Stops Bleeders; heals 1-2 Injury Levels; cures minor infections.
  • FGU Effect: Healed; Bleeding Stopped
  • Animus of Nithri (V): Primal empathetic sovereignty.
  • Effect: Beasts and natural predators are completely Pacified / Charmed; will not attack and follow simple instincts.
  • FGU Effect: Pacified; Charmed

docs.title: Odivshe (Water / Cold / Shadow)
docs.text:
• Azure Hand (I) & Shadow of Yanar (II): Deep shadow synthesis.
  • Effect: Extinguishes non-magical light. Caster or area surrounded by absolute gloom; exterior observers suffer Blinded / Concealed penalties.
  • FGU Effect: Shadow Cloak; DEF: 20
  • Breath of Dhivu (III) & Pall of Veshel (IV): Freezing gale and creeping permafrost.
  • Save: Endurance test.
  • Effect: Targets suffer Frost (F) damage and become Chilled / Numbed. -10 to -20 penalty to physical dexterity; movement halved.
  • FGU Effect: Chilled; CHECK: -15; SPEED: /2
  • Mouth of Lathal (III): Amphibious pulmonary inversion.
  • Effect: Grants water breathing. However, if used offensively (or reversed as Curse of Balrin), victim's lungs fill with water on dry land, causing Drowning / Suffocation.
  • FGU Effect: Drowning; Asphyxiating
  • Curse of Balrin (IV): Desiccation or watery asphyxiation.
  • Save: Endurance × 3.
  • Effect: Inability to breathe air. Victim begins suffocating immediately on dry land.
  • FGU Effect: Suffocating; Drowning

docs.title: Savorya (Mind / Spirit / Knowledge)
docs.text:
• Ordeal of Frida (III): Nightmare psychosis excitation.

Compiled for the HarnMaster 3.5E Fantasy Grounds Unity development environment.

docs.title: HarnMaster 3.5E for Fantasy Grounds — User Manual
Introduction
docs.text: This manual covers the Fantasy Grounds Unity implementation of HarnMaster 3.5E. It focuses on how to use the software — what each button does, how the roll sequence works, and how data is laid out — rather than repeating the tabletop rules. Keep your HarnMaster rulebook handy for the underlying mechanics.

docs.title: The Character Sheet
docs.text:
The character sheet header always displays the character's name and a prominent UP / PP indicator: * UP (Universal Penalty): Cumulative penalty from open wounds and active fatigue levels (1 per wound + 1 per fatigue). Automatically penalizes all percentile skill and attack/defense rolls by -5 EML per UP point, and adds dice to Shock and Death tests. * PP (Physical Penalty): Combined penalty of Universal Penalty plus Encumbrance Penalty (UP + Encumbrance). Applies to physical tests, movement, fumbles, and stumbles.

The character sheet has six tabs:

Tab Contents Skills Attributes and skills, ML, SB calculations, and development rolls Powers Convocations, rituals, invocations, and psionics with power groups, actions, and general rolls Inventory Carried items, currencies, armor equipping, and encumbrance load/penalty calculation Combat Penalties summary (Fatigue, UP, PP), detailed injury list, and worn strike location armor map (B/E/P/F) Actions General combat action rolls (Shock, Stumble, Fumble, Location), weapons, aim zones, and range brackets GM Biographical background, appearance, social class, and birthdate/sunsign (GM-only)

docs.title: Skills Tab — Attributes
docs.text:
The top portion of the Skills tab always shows the character's fifteen attributes in a compact grid.

Main view (compact): Each row shows the attribute abbreviation and its Total score — the final value used in play. Click the roll button to make an attribute roll. The roll can be adjusted using the Modifier Box (see below).

Attribute Editor (detail popup): Click the Details button (top-right of the ATTRIBUTES header) to open the attribute editor in a separate window. Each row there shows:

Column Meaning Name Full attribute name Base The raw value set during character creation — editable Mod. A flat bonus (from species, magic, etc.) — editable Total Computed final value (Base + Mod.) — read-only

docs.title: Skills Tab
docs.text:
Below the attributes, the same tab shows the character's skill list in compact form.

Main view (compact): Each row shows:

Column Meaning Name Skill name (with speciality appended if set) SB Skill Base — computed from the linked attributes ML Mastery Level — the number rolled against; click to roll

Skills are grouped by skill group (Physical, Combat, etc.). Use the filter box at the bottom to search by name.

Rolling a skill: Click the roll button on the right of any skill row to send the roll to chat.

Detailed Skills Window: Click the Details button (top-right of the SKILLS header) to open the full skill editor in a wider popup window. Each row there shows all fields:

Column Meaning Name Skill name Speciality Optional specialization within the skill Skill Group Category (Physical, Combat, Crafts & Lore, etc.) Attributes The attributes the SB is derived from (up to three) Sunsigns Sunsign bonus value (if applicable) OML Opening Mastery Level — the initial ML at skill acquisition SB Skill Base — computed, read-only Dev. Development ranks added through play — editable ML Mastery Level — computed final value

The detailed window also has a Development Roll button per row (the dice icon next to ML). Use this to test whether the skill improves.

docs.title: Powers Tab — Magic, Invocations & Psionics
docs.text: The Powers tab manages all supernatural and mental disciplines in HarnMaster: Arcane Magic (Shek-Pvar), Clerical Miracles (Invocations & Rituals), and Psionic Talents.

docs.title: Top Panels: Penalties & General Actions
docs.text:
• Penalties Bar: Displays active Fatigue, Universal Penalty (UP), and Physical Penalty (PP) directly at the top of the powers tab.
  • Collapsible Actions Header: Clicking the ACTIONS header expands or collapses quick-roll buttons for Shock, Stumble, Fumble, and Strike Location, making emergency saves and tactical reactions immediately accessible without switching tabs.

docs.title: Power Traditions & Group Types
docs.text:
Characters organize abilities into customizable Power Groups via the group detail window: - Group Settings: Configure group display name, caster type, linked base skill (e.g., Convocation skill, Ritual skill, or Psionic talent), attack attribute, preparation mode, and Piety pool. - Arcane Magic (Shek-Pvar): Standard Harnic magic divided into Gray (Neutral) mysteries and six elemental Convocations:

Tradition / Convocation Element / Focus Spells & Scope Gray (Neutral) Fundamental / Common 22 universal spells (Dispell, Maintain, Ward, Soul Stealer, Attune, Arwyn's Bubble, etc.) Fyvria Earth / Nature 10 spells governing flora, fauna, natural healing, and earth spirits (Balm of Gresan, Verdant Hand, etc.) Jmorvi Metal / Craft 10 spells governing minerals, metallurgy, enchanting, and kinetics (Aspect of Tarus, Fist of Kuhan, etc.) Lyahvi Light / Air 10 spells governing optical illusions, color, invisibility, and atmosphere (Cloak of Kalaerin, Globe of Setath, etc.) Odivshe Water / Cold 10 spells governing ice, permafrost, darkness, liquid forms, and stealth (Breath of Dhivu, Shadow of Yanar, etc.) Peleahn Fire / Heat 10 spells governing thermal energy, pyrotechnics, smoke, and bodily heat (Sea of Fire, Skin of Lexesh, etc.) Savorya Mind / Spirit 10 spells governing telepathy, clairvoyance, memory, and cognitive shielding (Aron's Thought, Spirit Block, etc.)
  • Divine Religion (Invocations & Rituals):
  • Tracks divine favor via Piety Points (Piety / Max Piety).
  • Covers Common Church Rituals and domain-specific miracles across the pantheon (Agrik, Halea, Ilvir, Larani, Morgath, Naveh, Peoni, Sarajin, Save-K'nor, Siem).
  • Casting invocations consumes Piety points; failed tests or transgressions track divine displeasure.
  • Psionics & Esoteric Talents:
  • Innate mental disciplines rolled against specific Talent ML.
  • Psionic exertion inflicts direct Fatigue on the caster and triggers psionic shock tests upon critical failures.

docs.title: Power Action Types & Automation Engine
docs.text: Each power entry supports embedded interactive action rows: - Cast Action: Rolls against the caster's linked Convocation, Invocation, or Psionic skill ML. Automatically outputs the Degree of Success (CS, MS, MF, CF). - Degree of Success (DoS) Synchronization: The result of the Cast roll automatically propagates to child actions and synchronizes sibling action rows (cycler_power_dos), allowing spell damage, saving throw DCs, and secondary effects to adapt dynamically to Critical vs. Marginal casting outcomes. - Fatigue Cost Automation: Automatically increments character fatigue (hp.fatigue) upon casting (e.g. 1 FT for standard spells, doubled on failures or heavy castings), feeding directly into the Universal Penalty. - Six Modular Action Types: 1. Cast: Evaluates spell success and initiates the casting sequence. 2. Attack: Opposed melee/ranged spell attack rolls that integrate directly with the Combat Resolution Window (CRW). 3. PowerSave (Saving Throw): Prompts targets for attribute-based saves (STR, DEX, CON/STA, INT, WIL, AUR) with DC scaling and 4-degree resolution (CS, MS, MF, CF). 4. Damage: Rolls spell impact dice filtered by degree of success, applying damage aspect (Blunt, Edge, Point, Fire, Frost) and matrix multipliers. 5. Heal: Interactive healing actions that reduce injury levels or remove bleeding conditions. 6. Effect: Applies targeted HarnMaster conditions, wards, or buffs (e.g., Blinded, Invisible, Prone, Hastened) directly to tokens in the Combat Tracker. - Detail View: Full reference popup displaying complexity level, fatigue cost, casting time, range, duration, target types, and bonus effects.

docs.title: Inventory Tab
docs.text: The Inventory tab lists all items carried, monetary wealth, and encumbrance calculations:

docs.title: Carried Items & Armor Equipping
docs.text:
• Count / Name / Location: Quantity, item name, and stowage location.
  • Weight: Total weight calculated as Count × Unit Weight.
  • Carried State: Click the carried state icon to toggle between:
  • Not Carried (stored in camp/mount; ignored for weight)
  • Carried (stowed in backpack or sack; counts toward carried load)
  • Equipped (worn armor, clothing, or drawn weapons; automatically feeds protection into the strike location armor table)

docs.title: Encumbrance Section
docs.text: Encumbrance is calculated dynamically using character physical attributes: * Base Calculation: Average physical prowess computed as (STR + STA + WIL) / 3. * Equipped Load & Carried Load: Displays rounded total weights for equipped items and carried gear. * Total Load: Sum of all carried and equipped weight. * Penalty Base Cycler: Toggle between Equipped (standard Harnic armor-only encumbrance in combat) and Carried (total pack load). * Penalty: Computed as round(Load / Base). Feeds directly into Physical Penalty (PP), penalizing physical skills and movement by -5 EML per step.

docs.title: Combat Tab — Armor & Penalties
docs.text:
The Combat tab summarizes three key systems:

  1. Strike location armor — The strike location table showing B/E/P/F protection values per body location. See Combat Tab — Strike Locations below.
  2. Penalties list — A summary of active injury penalties feeding into Universal Penalty and Physical Penalty.
  3. Injury list — All current wounds. See Combat Tab — Injuries below.

docs.title: Combat Tab — Injuries & Medical Resolution
docs.text: Injuries are listed as a sub-panel on the Combat tab: * Compact Row: Shows the injury description, aspect, and Injury Level (IL: 1–5). * Two-Step Delete: Built-in delete control allows safe wound clearing.

docs.title: Detailed Injuries Window & Medical Resolution
docs.text:
Clicking the Details button on the INJURIES header opens the expanded Detailed Injuries Window (charsheet_injuries_detailed):

Column / Control Meaning Location / Description Body part affected and descriptive wound name (e.g. Bruised, Grievous Cut) Aspect Blunt, Edge, Point, Fire, or Frost IL (Injury Level) 1 to 5 (Minor = 1, Serious = 2–3, Grievous = 4–5) HR (Healing Rate) Days per healing step Date Incurred Calendar date formatted via Tuzyn Calendar (e.g. 24th Kelen) Notes Free-text clinical notes Treat Button (Roll) Opens the interactive Medical Resolution Window (MRW) for treatment, diagnosis, and surgical interventions Heal Button (Roll) Performs standard medical healing check progression

docs.title: Interactive Medical Resolution Window (MRW)
docs.text: The dedicated Medical Resolution Window guides physicians and GMs through official HarnMaster medical procedures: * Diagnosis: Diagnostic roll establishing bonus modifier for treatment. * Treatment: Applies medical treatment, adjusting wound status from Untreated to Tended/Treated and improving Healing Rate (HR). * Healing Cycle: Resolves 5-day healing intervals, testing condition and reducing Injury Levels upon success. * Infection Day: Daily infection checks for open, dirty, or untreated wounds. * Shock Watch: 4-hour watch recovery tests for characters in critical medical Shock. * Cauterization & Tourniquet: Emergency field procedures to staunch active Bleeders. * Surgical Amputation: Amputation resolution for non-viable limbs. * Bloodloss: Tracking active bleeders and cumulative bloodloss points.

docs.title: Combat Tab — Strike Locations
docs.text:
Located below the injuries sub-panel, the Strike Locations section displays the character's body map and armor protection:

Column Meaning Strike Locations Body location name (Skull, Face, Neck, Thorax, Shoulders, Arms, Hands, Abdomen, Groin, Hips, Legs, Feet) B / E / P / F Total armor protection at that location for Blunt, Edge, Point, and Fire Cover Cover rating status (e.g. low wall, shield cover, or fortifications) providing additional protective mitigation

During combat resolution, the system rolls against this table (or High/Low aim sub-tables) to determine exactly where a hit lands and automatically applies the corresponding armor and cover mitigation.

docs.title: Actions Tab — Weapons & General Actions
docs.text: The Actions tab is the primary interface for combat rolls and quick emergency saves.

docs.title: General Actions Panel
docs.text: At the top of the Actions tab, the ACTIONS panel provides one-click rolls for essential combat reactions: * Shock: Performs an immediate System Shock roll. Roll uses math.max(1, UP) d6 vs. the character's Endurance (or Condition skill/5). * Stumble: Rolls 3d6 (plus physical penalty) vs. Agility. Failure causes the character to fall Prone and adds the condition to the Combat Tracker. * Fumble: Rolls 3d6 (plus physical penalty) vs. Dexterity. Failure drops held weapons or shields. * Strike Location: Performs a strike location roll against the default Harnic hit location table and announces the struck body part.

docs.title: Weapon Row Controls
docs.text:
Weapon entries can be reordered in the list by dragging them to the desired position.

Control Function Name Weapon or attack name (underlined; click to rename) Attack (Sword icon) Click to make an attack roll; displays current effective AML Defend (Shield icon) Click to make a defense roll; displays current effective DML Damage (Fist icon) Click to roll damage; displays dice for the active aspect Damage Aspect Cycles between Blunt, Edge, and Point Aim Zone Cycles between High (-10 EML), Mid (default), and Low (-10 EML) Range Bracket Current range band for ranged/thrown weapons: Short (+10), Medium (0), Long (-20), Extreme (-40) Ammo Counter Tracks remaining ammunition with an interactive pip display

docs.title: Weapon Editor (Detail Popup)
docs.text:
Click the detail button (grid icon, right side of each weapon row) to configure weapon stats:

Field Meaning Weapon Display name WQ / Current Base Weapon Quality and current condition rating Note Free-text notes (e.g. ammo type, special rules) Type Melee, Ranged, or Thrown Skill Base weapon skill used for ML calculation A / D / HM Attack modifier, Defense modifier, and Handmode penalty B / E / P Base damage dice for Blunt, Edge, and Point aspects Range S/M/L/E Range thresholds in metres for each bracket Properties Notes on special qualities or magical attributes

docs.title: Adding Attack Entries
docs.text:
Right-click anywhere in the weapon list to access the radial menu:

  • Add Melee — Adds a melee weapon entry
  • Add Ranged — Adds a ranged weapon entry
  • Add Throwing — Adds a thrown weapon entry

docs.title: GM Tab — Background
docs.text:
The GM tab is visible only to the GM and tracks character background:

  • Birthdate, Sunsign, Sunsign (Cusp)
  • Species, Gender
  • Height, Frame, Weight
  • Hair Color, Eye Color, Voice
  • Culture, Social Class
  • Speed (calculated from MOV)

Sunsign affinities automatically grant bonuses to matching skills on the Skills tab.

docs.title: Making Rolls
docs.text:
All rolls in HarnMaster follow a percentile (d100) test compared against the target Mastery Level (ML):

Result Meaning Critical Success (CS) Roll ≤ ML ending in 5 or 0 Marginal Success (MS) Roll ≤ ML (or natural 01–05) Marginal Failure (MF) Roll > ML (or natural 96–00) Critical Failure (CF) Roll > ML ending in 5 or 0

How to roll:

  • Attribute check: Click the roll button next to an attribute on the Skills tab
  • Skill check: Click the roll button on the Skills tab
  • Attack: Click the sword button on the Actions tab
  • Defense: Click the shield button
  • Damage: Click the damage button
  • Saves & Reactions: Click the Shock, Stumble, Fumble, or Location roll buttons

docs.title: The Modifier Box
docs.text:
The Modifier Box is a floating desktop panel that applies situational modifiers to the next roll:

  • Numeric modifier: Type any number or click the +2, -2, +5, -5 buttons to apply flat bonuses or penalties.
  • SB Multipliers (×2 through ×7): Multiplies Skill Base for difficulty scaling on attribute and skill checks:
Preset Target Difficulty ×2 Target = SB × 2 (Very Hard) ×3 Target = SB × 3 (Hard) ×4 Target = SB × 4 (Moderate) ×5 Target = SB × 5 — Default (Standard) ×6 Target = SB × 6 (Easy) ×7 Target = SB × 7 (Trivial)

For damage rolls, multiplier buttons multiply the number of damage dice rolled together (e.g. x2 rolls 2d6).

docs.title: Tactical & Situational Preset Modifiers
docs.text: The Modifier Box includes built-in HarnMaster tactical buttons: * DEF_COVER (Low Cover): -10 EML to incoming attacks; strikes landing on covered zones hit plate obstacle (B6/E10/P6/F2). * DEF_SCOVER (High Cover): -20 EML; arrow slits / firing ports. * DEF_TCOVER (Full Cover): Complete barrier; all strikes hit the obstacle. * DEF_PRONE: Applies -15 EML against ranged attacks (reduced silhouette) and -20 EML when defending in melee, while granting melee attackers +20 EML against the prone target. * ATT_OPP (Opportunity): Attack of opportunity modifiers.

docs.title: Combat
docs.text: Combat resolves in three distinct steps: Attack → Defense → Damage.

docs.title: Initiative
docs.text:
• Right-click a combatant in the Combat Tracker and select Set Initiative.
  • Use Set All Initiatives, Set NPC Initiatives, or Set PC Initiatives.

docs.title: Attack
docs.text:
1. Click the sword button on the Actions tab.
  2. The attack roll posts to chat with the AML, d100 roll, and outcome (CS/MS/MF/CF).
  3. Aim Zones: Set the Aim Zone (High, Mid, Low) prior to rolling. High/Low aim zones apply a -10 EML modifier. If an attacker is prone, high aim zones are out of reach.
  4. Creature Size Modifiers: Attacking a creature of a different size step automatically applies a ±10 EML modifier per step difference (e.g. larger targets are easier to hit; smaller targets harder).

docs.title: Defense
docs.text:
The defender responds by choosing one of four tactical actions:

Defense Effect Block Uses weapon/shield defense ML to deflect the attack Counterstrike Attacks in return; both rolls resolve simultaneously Dodge Uses Agility-based dodge to evade Ignore Takes no action; attack resolves at maximum effectiveness

Defenders suffering from the Prone condition suffer a -20 EML penalty on defense rolls.

docs.title: Damage
docs.text: The attacker rolls damage via the damage button according to the active aspect (Blunt, Edge, Point): * Base damage dice are modified by the weapon rating. * Creature Size Difference Impact: Physical impact is automatically adjusted by ±1 point per size step difference between attacker and defender. * When targeting a combatant with an open Combat Resolution Window, rolling damage automatically updates the resolution window.

docs.title: Shock & Kill (Death) Rolls
docs.text:
Taking an injury automatically triggers a Shock Roll: * Shock Pool: Rolls 1d6 per point of Universal Penalty (UP). If the total rolled exceeds the character's Endurance (or Condition skill / 5), the roll fails. * Kill Rolls (Death Tests): Severe or lethal damage triggers a Kill roll using the same UP dice pool vs. Endurance. Failing the Kill roll immediately applies the Dead condition.

Current State Roll Outcome Resulting State Normal Fail → Unconscious + Prone Unconscious Pass → Incapacitated + immediate second check Incapacitated Fail → Shock (Medical critical state) Incapacitated Pass → Conditions removed (Recovered)

docs.title: The Combat Tracker
docs.text:
Key HarnMaster features on the Combat Tracker:

  • Locations: Quick access to strike location tables and current armor values
  • Injuries: Summary of active wounds and current penalty total
  • Fatigue (FT): Inline fatigue tracking

Running combat from the Combat Tracker:

  • Set initiative: Set initiative and sort the tracker list.
  • Select active combatant: Click their token or tracker entry to activate.
  • Target opponent: Drag the target crosshair to link attacker to defender.
  • Roll directly: Use weapon buttons on the CT entry to roll attack and damage directly without opening the full sheet.

docs.title: Combat Resolution
docs.text:
Combat interactions (attack vs. defense, hit location determination, armor mitigation, and injury generation) are resolved using the dedicated Combat Resolution Window.

👉 For complete details and a step-by-step walkthrough, see the Combat Resolution guide.

docs.title: NPCs
docs.text:
Create NPCs from the NPCs sidebar menu:

  • Attributes: Compact grid identical to PC sheets
  • Skills: Free-text multi-roll field (e.g. Sword 65, Riding 42)
  • Actions: Narrative actions and abilities list
  • Weapons: Drag and drop weapon items directly into the Actions section
  • Hit Locations: Click Add default Strike Locations to populate humanoid location tables
  • Armor Values: Click Refresh Armor Values after equipping armor

docs.title: Encounters
docs.text: Build encounters in the Encounters module and push them directly to the Combat Tracker when combat begins.

docs.title: GM Options
docs.text:
Under Settings → Options → HarnMaster Rules:

Option Effect Combat: Knockbacks Enables knockback rolls on heavy impact hits Combat: Limb injuries Tracks unusable limb conditions Combat: Amputations Enables amputation outcomes on grievous limb wounds Combat: Bleeders Adds blood-loss tracking for severe wounds
